run_insecure_interop_tests: run the InsecureLocalInteropTest class to test gRPC async interoperability over an insecure channel
run_secure_interop_tests: run the SecureLocalInteropTest class to test gRPC async interoperability over an SSL-secured channel
test_empty_unary_call: test the InteropTestCaseMixin test_empty_unary method to verify empty unary RPC calls work correctly
test_streaming_calls: test the InteropTestCaseMixin test_server_streaming and test_client_streaming methods to verify bidirectional streaming RPCs
test_cancellation_and_timeout: test the InteropTestCaseMixin test_cancel_after_begin and test_timeout_on_sleeping_server methods to verify RPC cancellation and timeout behavior
